document.title: Brocade SANnav Management Portal REST API Reference Manual

capability_sources.note: Response envelope key ("Fabrics") and field names (name, principalSwitchWwn) confirmed both against a real, independently-authored working script and against the FabricResponse/FabricDetails schema in the authoritative REST API Reference Manual (v3.0.1x).

Requires a principalSwitchWWN query parameter. Response envelope key ("Switches") and ipAddress field confirmed against the same working script and against the FabricMemberResponse/SwitchDetails schema in the reference manual.

Request body and response envelope (FaultEventDetailsCriteria / FaultEventsResponse: top-level "events" array plus a "totalRecords" total count) confirmed against the authoritative REST API Reference Manual (v3.0.1x). This also corrected a real bug found during reconciliation: the connector's request body previously scoped events with an ORIGIN-column filter whose value was set to the switch WWN, but ORIGIN's documented values are event-source labels ("Syslog Message", "SNMP Trap", ...), never a WWN -- the manual's own worked example confirms the correct field is the top-level "eventProductDetails" array of virtual switch WWNs. Per-event severity is still not parsed: the manual's own worked example returns a severityGroup value ("MAJOR") absent from its own declared SeverityGroup enum (ALL/ALERT/ERROR/WARNING/INFO/UNKNOWN), so that specific vocabulary remains unconfirmed even against the authoritative reference.

Version/compatibility endpoint (introduced in SANnav v2.3.1), confirmed via the About schema in the reference manual: {version, build, generatedOn, productBrandName, oemName}. Used only by self_test() and the connection-test probe, not exposed as a package capability -- see "self_test_source" below.

authentication_source.note: This connector deliberately uses SANnav's documented session-less mode (Base64 Basic-auth header on every request) instead of the stateful login/sessionId flow, so it fits the existing per-request authorization-header credential materializer pattern already used for every other connector in this codebase without a framework change.

self_test_source.note: Corrects an earlier gap: SANnav was believed to have no dedicated version/compatibility endpoint equivalent to Hitachi's /configuration/version, so self_test() reused the fabric-discovery read as a proxy. The reference manual (v3.0.1x) confirms a real one exists (GET /external-api/v1/about/, returning productBrandName/version); self_test() and the connection-test probe both use it now, mirroring the Hitachi read_api_version() pattern exactly.
